item.name: Private Secret Local Sandbars Escape
item.description:
#Escape the crowds and discover your private paradise with our Secret Sandbars Charter in Key West. 

##Duration
 4 Hours

##About
Cruise to secluded sandbars and uninhabited islands, where pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters await. Unwind in blissful seclusion as you bask in the sun, explore tide pools teeming with marine life, or indulge in a leisurely picnic amidst breathtaking natural beauty. With our experienced crew catering to your every need, you can relax and enjoy the ultimate beach getaway without worrying. This hidden gem is yours to explore – the perfect antidote to the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

##Complimentary
All charter passengers may use The Perry Hotel and Marina Pools as my guests before and after the charter. David, Owner
item.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Secret Sandbar Escape Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Secret Sandbar Escape — a private 4-hour journey to secluded Key West sandbars far from the crowds.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and unforgettable experience.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Trip

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

Please complete all forms prior to arrival so we can depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🏝 Your Secret Sandbar Escape

This is a private, customizable 4-hour charter designed around tides and conditions.

Your captain will guide you through turquoise backcountry waters to secluded sandbars and uninhabited islands such as:

• Marvin Key Sandbar
• Jewfish Basin
• Boca Grande Key
• Mud Keys backcountry shallows
• Snipe Key Sandbar

Locations are selected based on weather and tide conditions to ensure the best experience.

Swim, float, relax on the lily pad, paddleboard, explore tide pools, or simply unwind in peaceful seclusion.

No crowds. No tour traffic. Just you and the Keys.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 About the Boat

• 30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender
• Private enclosed head (toilet)
• USCG-certified safety equipment
• Licensed USCG captains

Departure Location:
Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What's Included

• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water & light snacks
• Snorkeling gear
• Adult noodles
• Lily pad (upon request)
• Stand-up paddleboard (upon request)

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & beverages
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain & crew gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by USCG-licensed captains
• Safety briefing provided before departure
• Life jackets available for all guests
• Sandbar access is tide- and weather-dependent
• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Guests should be comfortable around water and physically able to board the vessel and step into shallow water if participating.

Not recommended for guests who are pregnant or those with serious heart, back, neck, or recent surgical conditions.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• Itineraries are subject to weather, tides, and the captain's discretion
• Sandbar conditions vary daily
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools before and after your trip.

Make it a full Keys day.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

We look forward to hosting your private escape.

Best regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter
item.cancellation_notes:
Enjoy peace of mind with our cancellation policy:

All reservations made within 7 calendar days of departure are non-refundable. Customer cancellations made prior to 7 calendar days before departure will receive a full refund. If Six Fins Charter cancels due to unsafe weather conditions or other circumstances initiated by the owner/operator, the customer will receive a full refund.
item.headline: The quiet sandbars locals run to — not the Boca Grande boat-party crowd

facts.hygiene_policy:
Your safety is our highest priority.

All Secret Sandbar charters are operated by experienced, U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains and follow all applicable federal and local safety regulations. A safety briefing is provided prior to departure.

• U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets are available for all guests
• Required safety equipment is onboard at all times
• Routes and sandbar locations are selected based on current weather, wind, and tide conditions
• Swimming and sandbar activities are weather- and tide-dependent

Guests should be in good physical health and comfortable around water. If you have medical conditions (including heart conditions, back or neck issues, recent surgeries, pregnancy, or mobility limitations), please consult your physician before booking and notify us in advance.

Children must be supervised by a parent or guardian at all times.

Guests who appear excessively intoxicated or unable to safely participate may be denied boarding or returned to the marina without refund.

Our captains reserve the right to modify the itinerary at any time for safety.

Food allergies and dietary restrictions: Please inform us in advance if you or anyone in your party has a food allergy or dietary restriction, so we can prepare accordingly. Reply to your confirmation email or call us.

Prone to seasickness: Let us know in advance and we can suggest what to take before you board.

start_location.note: We depart from and return to The Perry Hotel & Marina, Dock A, Slip #32. Free parking is available next to the dock — just turn into the hotel at 7001 Shrimp Road. Your charter includes complimentary access to the Perry Hotel pools and fitness center — an approximately $35 value — before or after your trip. No check-in needed; please bring your own towels. David McFadden, Owner
